name: Simone Gipaldi
source:
Edgar's mother.
[url=/c54026]Edgar[/url] and [url=/c54032]Cossette's[/url] mother and [url=/c54033]Austin's[/url] wife.
The former princess of the neighboring country of Brahist.
She's very self-conceited and has absolute confidence in herself.

(CV.水戸 沙哉)
